saudiVision.title: Saudi Vision 2030
saudiVision.subtitle: A bold blueprint for transforming Saudi Arabia into a global leader in economic, social, and cultural development.
saudiVision.overviewText: Saudi Vision 2030 is a strategic framework launched in 2016 by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to reduce its dependence on oil, diversify its economy, and develop public service sectors such as health, education, infrastructure, recreation, and tourism. It aims to position Saudi Arabia as a global investment powerhouse and a hub connecting three continents: Asia, Europe, and Africa.
saudiVision.pillarVibrantText: The goal of a vibrant society is to create a rich and fulfilling life for all citizens and residents. This includes promoting cultural and entertainment opportunities, preserving Saudi heritage, and improving the quality of life through world-class healthcare and education.
saudiVision.pillarThrivingText: A thriving economy focuses on diversifying income sources, empowering the private sector, and creating job opportunities for all. It emphasizes innovation, entrepreneurship, and attracting foreign investment to drive sustainable growth.
saudiVision.pillarAmbitiousText: An ambitious nation aims to enhance government effectiveness, transparency, and accountability. It seeks to foster a culture of responsibility and volunteerism, ensuring that all citizens contribute to the nation’s progress.
targetsList: Increase private sector GDP contribution from 40% to 65%.
Raise foreign direct investment from 3.8% to 5.7% of GDP.
Grow non-oil revenue from SAR 163 billion to SAR 1 trillion.
Improve the quality of life index ranking to be among the top 10 globally.
Increase the number of volunteers from 11,000 to 1 million.
Enhance e-government services and digital transformation.
saudiVision.impactText: Vision 2030 presents immense opportunities for businesses, society, and the global community. It fosters a dynamic business environment, attracts foreign investment, and drives infrastructure development. The vision also enhances the quality of life for citizens and residents, creating a sustainable and diversified economy for future generations.

smart-home-systems.title: Smart Home & Automation
smart-home-systems.description: Integrated smart home automation for comfort, security, and energy control.
smart-home-systems.shortDescription: Integrated smart home automation for comfort, security, and energy control.
smart-home-systems.fullDescription:
AQTRA designs and implements smart home and building automation systems that unify lighting, HVAC, access, audio/visual, and safety into one reliable platform. Our solutions are engineered for modern villas, apartments, offices, and hospitality environments where usability, stability, and future expansion are critical.

We deliver end-to-end automation including wiring and low-current infrastructure, controllers and gateways, mobile/voice integration, and centralized monitoring. Typical systems include smart lighting (dimming, scenes), smart locks and access, curtain/shutter control, HVAC scheduling and zoning, energy metering, leak/smoke integrations, home theater and multi-room audio, and remote access with secure user management.

systemSelectionGuide.overview: The right automation approach depends on building size, finishing stage, reliability expectations, and integration scope.

options.whenToChoose: When you want maximum reliability, scalable expansion, and clean integration across multiple subsystems.
options.notes: Enables structured cabling, centralized control panels, and stable performance independent of Wi‑Fi coverage.

options.whenToChoose: When civil works must be minimized while still adding key smart features.
options.notes: A hybrid design keeps critical functions on wired backbone and uses wireless endpoints where practical.

keyFactors: Number of zones (lighting/HVAC) and future rooms
Network quality and power backup requirements
Integration scope (CCTV, access control, intercom, AV)
User experience (keypads, app, voice) and guest mode

warrantyAndGuarantee.systemWarranty: Manufacturer warranty on controllers, actuators, keypads, and smart devices as per brand terms.
warrantyAndGuarantee.workmanshipGuarantee: Workmanship guarantee covering installation quality, termination, labeling, and commissioning.
standardsAndApprovals: Low-current and structured cabling best practices
Secure network configuration and access control policy

benefits: Improved comfort through zoning, scenes, and scheduling
Enhanced security with integrated access and monitoring
Energy optimization via smart control and metering
Scalable platform for future devices and integrations
Centralized control with clear, user-friendly interfaces

solar-energy.title: Solar Energy Systems
solar-energy.description: Engineering, procurement, and installation of high-performance solar PV systems.
solar-energy.shortDescription: Engineering, procurement, and installation of high-performance solar PV systems.
solar-energy.fullDescription:
AQTRA delivers solar photovoltaic (PV) solutions for residential, commercial, and industrial sites—designed to reduce energy cost, stabilize power, and improve sustainability. Our scope covers site assessment, PV sizing, structural and electrical design, procurement, installation, commissioning, and monitoring.

We implement complete PV systems including modules and mounting structures, string or hybrid inverters, DC/AC protection, earthing and lightning protection, energy meters, monitoring portals, and optional battery storage. For special applications we design solar pumping systems and off-grid solutions with load management.

systemSelectionGuide.overview: System type should match your consumption profile, grid availability, backup requirements, and space constraints.

options.whenToChoose: When the goal is maximum ROI through net metering/self-consumption and you do not need long backup duration.
options.notes: Typically the most cost-effective per kWp and simplest to maintain.

options.whenToChoose: When utility power is unavailable and autonomy is required.
options.notes: Requires batteries and careful load management; sizing is driven by critical loads and autonomy hours.

options.bestFor: Sites needing backup and peak shaving
options.whenToChoose: When you want solar savings plus power continuity for critical loads.
options.notes: Enables backup, peak demand reduction, and smart energy management.

keyFactors: Monthly energy usage and daytime load profile
Available roof/ground area and shading analysis
Backup duration and critical load list
typicalDeliverables: Energy audit and PV yield estimate

warrantyAndGuarantee.systemWarranty: PV module performance and product warranties plus inverter warranty per manufacturer terms.
warrantyAndGuarantee.workmanshipGuarantee: Installation workmanship guarantee covering mounting, cabling, labeling, and commissioning.
standardsAndApprovals: Utility and net-metering requirements where applicable
Local inspection and documentation for approvals

benefits: Lower electricity bills and reduced peak demand
High reliability with monitoring and protection
Scalable capacity expansion as loads grow
Reduced carbon footprint and sustainability reporting
Optional backup power with hybrid storage

hvac-chiller.title: HVAC & Chiller Systems
hvac-chiller.description: Complete HVAC engineering for thermal comfort, air quality, and energy efficiency.
hvac-chiller.shortDescription: Complete HVAC engineering for thermal comfort, air quality, and energy efficiency.
hvac-chiller.fullDescription:
AQTRA provides HVAC solutions that deliver stable indoor comfort and healthy air quality for villas, offices, retail, hospitals, and industrial facilities. Our engineers design and install systems covering cooling/heating capacity, ventilation, filtration, humidity control, acoustics, and energy optimization.

Scope includes load calculation, equipment selection, ducting fabrication and installation, chilled water piping, AHU/FCU installation, controls and thermostats, commissioning, and testing & balancing (TAB). We integrate HVAC controls with BMS and smart automation where required.

systemSelectionGuide.overview: Selecting the right HVAC system depends on building size, zoning needs, ceiling height, usage pattern, and lifecycle cost.

options.whenToChoose: When budget is tight and zoning is limited.
options.notes: Simple installation and maintenance; efficiency depends on correct sizing and duct design.

options.whenToChoose: When you need many indoor units with independent control and high part-load efficiency.
options.notes: Excellent zoning and expandability; requires expert design and refrigerant piping practices.

options.whenToChoose: When centralized cooling and high capacity are required.
options.notes: Supports AHUs/FCUs; offers strong lifecycle economics when engineered and maintained correctly.

keyFactors: Number of zones and control requirements
Energy efficiency targets and operating hours
typicalDeliverables: Heat load calculation and equipment schedule
Ducting layout and static pressure sizing

warrantyAndGuarantee.systemWarranty: HVAC equipment warranty per manufacturer terms (compressors, controls, and major components).
warrantyAndGuarantee.workmanshipGuarantee: Workmanship guarantee covering duct/piping installation, insulation, drainage, and commissioning.
standardsAndApprovals: Ventilation and indoor air quality practices

benefits: Consistent comfort and improved indoor air quality
Lower operating cost through efficient selection and controls
Reliable operation with correct commissioning
Scalable zoning for future space changes
Reduced noise and better thermal stability

plumbing.title: Plumbing Systems
plumbing.description: Water supply, drainage, and pumping solutions engineered for reliability and hygiene.
plumbing.shortDescription: Water supply, drainage, and pumping solutions engineered for reliability and hygiene.
plumbing.fullDescription:
AQTRA delivers complete plumbing and water systems for residential and commercial buildings. Our services cover cold and hot water networks, sanitary drainage, stormwater drainage, pumping systems, and water heater solutions—engineered for safety, hygiene, and long-term performance.

We provide material selection and proper installation methods for piping, valves, insulation, and supports, with careful attention to pressure management, backflow prevention, and leak mitigation. Where required, we integrate leak detection and monitoring to protect property and reduce water loss.

systemSelectionGuide.overview: The best plumbing design depends on demand, water pressure, fixture count, and the building’s vertical layout.

options.whenToChoose: Use gravity wherever possible; select pumps where elevation or routing constraints exist.
options.notes: Correct venting and slope are critical for odor control and performance.

options.whenToChoose: Central systems suit high demand; point-of-use reduces distribution losses for smaller loads.
options.notes: Consider recirculation for long pipe runs to reduce waiting time.

keyFactors: Building height and booster pump needs
typicalDeliverables: Plumbing layout, riser diagrams, and valve schedule

warrantyAndGuarantee.systemWarranty: Manufacturer warranty for pumps, heaters, and fixtures per brand terms.
warrantyAndGuarantee.workmanshipGuarantee: Workmanship guarantee covering pipe joints, supports, insulation, and leak-free commissioning.

benefits: Reliable water distribution and stable pressure
Reduced leaks through correct materials and testing
Efficient hot water delivery and energy savings
Maintainable zoning with clear isolation points
Protection against water damage with leak monitoring

fire-fighting.title: Fire Alarm & Fire Fighting
fire-fighting.description: Code-compliant fire detection and suppression systems for life safety.
fire-fighting.shortDescription: Code-compliant fire detection and suppression systems for life safety.
fire-fighting.fullDescription:
AQTRA engineers and installs fire alarm and fire fighting systems that protect people, assets, and operations. Our scope covers detection and notification, suppression design, fire pump rooms, and complete commissioning to meet project requirements.

We implement systems such as addressable fire alarm, smoke/heat detection, manual call points, horn/strobe notification, sprinkler and standpipe networks, hydrants, fire pumps, and special suppression where required (subject to design). We coordinate drawings, calculations, and site testing with project stakeholders.

systemSelectionGuide.overview: System selection depends on occupancy type, risk category, authority requirements, and the protected asset value.

options.whenToChoose: Addressable systems are preferred for larger buildings and precise event location.
options.notes: Addressable panels simplify troubleshooting and reporting.

options.whenToChoose: Use sprinklers/hydrants for most occupancies; consider special suppression for server rooms or sensitive equipment.
options.notes: Final selection must align with consultant and authority approvals.

keyFactors: Water supply availability and pump sizing

warrantyAndGuarantee.systemWarranty: Manufacturer warranty for panels, detectors, and pumps per brand terms.
warrantyAndGuarantee.workmanshipGuarantee: Workmanship guarantee covering installation quality, cabling, labeling, and testing.

benefits: Improved life safety through early detection and clear evacuation
Reduced asset loss with engineered suppression
Compliance-ready documentation for approvals
Reliable operation with routine testing and maintenance
Integrations that reduce false alarms and improve response

electrical.title: Electrical Systems
electrical.description: Low-voltage power distribution, lighting, and protection systems built to code.
electrical.shortDescription: Low-voltage power distribution, lighting, and protection systems built to code.
electrical.fullDescription:
AQTRA delivers electrical engineering and installation for residential, commercial, and industrial projects. Our scope covers LV power distribution, panel boards, lighting, earthing, surge protection, backup systems, and testing/commissioning.

We design circuits and protection coordination, implement high-quality cable management and termination, and provide clear labeling and documentation. Where required, we integrate low-current systems (CCTV, access control, networking) and coordinate interfaces with automation and fire alarm.

systemSelectionGuide.overview: Electrical design should be planned around load profile, safety, expansion capacity, and operational continuity.

options.whenToChoose: Required for safe energy distribution and protection.
options.notes: Includes MDB/SMDB/DBs, breakers, cables, earthing, and surge protection.

options.whenToChoose: When you need structured data cabling, CCTV, access control, intercom, and system integrations.
options.notes: Often implemented alongside power works for optimal routing and coordination.

keyFactors: Connected load, demand factor, and diversity
Space for electrical rooms and panel locations
Future expansion capacity and spare ways

warrantyAndGuarantee.systemWarranty: Manufacturer warranty for switchgear, breakers, luminaires, and equipment per brand terms.
warrantyAndGuarantee.workmanshipGuarantee: Workmanship guarantee covering cable installation, terminations, labeling, and testing.
standardsAndApprovals: Local electrical regulations and inspection requirements

benefits: Safe and reliable power distribution
Reduced downtime with proper protection and backup planning
Energy efficiency through optimized lighting and controls
Scalable infrastructure with spare capacity
Clean documentation for operations and maintenance

network-security.title: IT / Network Systems
network-security.description: Structured cabling and enterprise networking designed for performance and security.
network-security.shortDescription: Structured cabling and enterprise networking designed for performance and security.
network-security.fullDescription:
AQTRA delivers IT and network infrastructure for homes, offices, retail, hospitality, and industrial sites. We design and implement the physical layer (structured cabling) and the active layer (switching, routing, Wi‑Fi) to ensure stable performance, coverage, and security.

Our scope includes rack and patch panel installation, copper/fiber termination, labeling, network design, Wi‑Fi heatmap planning, CCTV and access control network integration, and structured handover documentation. We follow best practices for segmentation, secure remote access, and expansion readiness.

systemSelectionGuide.overview: Start with a clear separation between passive infrastructure (cabling) and active equipment (switches/routers/Wi‑Fi).

options.whenToChoose: Always recommended as a backbone for data, CCTV, VoIP, and automation.
options.notes: Correct pathway planning, labeling, and testing are essential.

options.whenToChoose: When you need VLAN segmentation, PoE powering, managed Wi‑Fi, and scalable expansion.
options.notes: Design should account for coverage, bandwidth, redundancy, and future devices.

keyFactors: Number of endpoints (CCTV, APs, phones, IoT)
typicalDeliverables: Cabling layouts, labeling scheme, and test results

warrantyAndGuarantee.systemWarranty: Manufacturer warranty for network equipment per brand terms; cabling system warranty as applicable.
warrantyAndGuarantee.workmanshipGuarantee: Workmanship guarantee covering termination, labeling, configuration baseline, and testing.
standardsAndApprovals: Structured cabling best practices and certification
Secure configuration and access control policy

benefits: Reliable connectivity and consistent Wi‑Fi coverage
Security through segmentation and controlled access
Scalable capacity for future devices and services
Reduced troubleshooting time with proper labeling
Improved uptime with UPS and redundancy planning

landscape-irrigation.title: Landscaping & Smart Irrigation
landscape-irrigation.description: Outdoor landscaping with efficient irrigation, lighting, and drainage engineering.
landscape-irrigation.shortDescription: Outdoor landscaping with efficient irrigation, lighting, and drainage engineering.
landscape-irrigation.fullDescription:
AQTRA provides landscaping and irrigation solutions that combine aesthetics with engineering performance. We deliver softscape and hardscape works, smart irrigation design, landscape lighting, and drainage for villas, compounds, commercial facilities, and public spaces.

Our irrigation designs include drip and sprinkler networks, pressure regulation, valves and controllers, pump and filtration arrangements, and water-efficient scheduling. We coordinate planting selection and soil preparation with hydraulic zoning to ensure healthy growth and minimum water waste.

systemSelectionGuide.overview: A successful outdoor project balances design intent, site conditions, water availability, and maintenance capacity.

options.whenToChoose: When the focus is greenery, shading, and natural aesthetics.
options.notes: Requires irrigation zoning and soil preparation matched to plant types.

options.bestFor: Pathways, patios, walls, and outdoor structures
options.whenToChoose: When you need durable outdoor circulation and functional areas.
options.notes: Drainage and sub-base preparation are critical for longevity.

options.whenToChoose: When you want optimized watering schedules and remote control.
options.notes: Controllers, sensors, and pressure regulation reduce waste and improve plant health.

keyFactors: Plant types, sun exposure, and soil conditions

warrantyAndGuarantee.systemWarranty: Manufacturer warranty for controllers, pumps, valves, and lighting fixtures per brand terms.
warrantyAndGuarantee.workmanshipGuarantee: Workmanship guarantee covering installation quality, alignment, and irrigation performance tests.
standardsAndApprovals: Site drainage coordination with civil works

benefits: Improved curb appeal and usable outdoor spaces
Reduced water consumption through smart scheduling
Healthier planting with correct zoning and filtration
Lower maintenance issues through proper drainage
Expandable design for future outdoor additions
